name: NHC Foods Limited
summary: NHC Foods Limited concentrates its efforts on the milling and preparation of spices. The company operates within distinct geographical areas, namely India and various international markets. It ships a wide array of goods overseas, such as spices, oil seeds, dried grapes, chickpeas, livestock feed, dehydrated foods, and other edible commodities. The enterprise was established on August 4, 1992, and its corporate offices are situated in Navi Mumbai, India.
